name: Mark bad data
summary: Marks bad channels and annotates bad time segments by hand in MNE-Python epoched MEG/EEG data, saving the updated epochs.
description: Appends the listed channel names to epo.info['bads'] and, if given, parses the multiline annotations text (onset, duration, description[, channels]) into mne.Annotations that replace existing annotations. Use it to record manual QC decisions before later processing. Channel names are not validated; as committed, the channel check for channel-specific annotations refers to an undefined variable, so such annotations will fail.

outputs.description: The input epochs with updated bad channels and annotations (meg-epo.fif).

parameters.description: A multiline text describing segments to discard, following a format compatible with mne.Annotations: "start, duration, description[, channels]"

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
